name: Congress.gov API
tagline: Official REST API for U.S. congressional legislative data from Congress.gov
description: Public API from the Library of Congress providing structured access to bills, amendments, members, committees, nominations, treaties, and related legislative data on Congress.gov. Requires a free API key; responses are primarily JSON.

auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header or api_key query parameter; free self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — free key required; published rate limit 5,000 requests/hour

rate_limits: 5,000 requests per hour per API key (published)
use_cases: look up a bill by congress, type, and number
list recent bills for a given Congress
get member bio and sponsored legislation
retrieve amendment details for a bill
